  20: // It provides a fluent interface for configuring all aspects of the service
  21: // including authentication, file watching, HTTP server options, and lifecycle hooks.
  22: type Builder struct {

  24: 	cfg *config.Config

  45: 	accessManager *sdkaccess.Manager
  46: 
  47: 	// coreManager handles core authentication and execution.

 167: // Build validates inputs, applies defaults, and returns a ready-to-run service.
 168: func (b *Builder) Build() (*Service, error) {
 169: 	if b.cfg == nil {
 170: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cliproxy: configuration is required")
 171: 	}
 172: 	if b.configPath == "" {
 173: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cliproxy: configuration path is required")
 174: 	}
 175: 
 176: 	tokenProvider := b.tokenProvider
 177: 	if tokenProvider == nil {
 178: 		tokenProvider = NewFileTokenClientProvider()
 179: 	}
 180:

 182: 	if apiKeyProvider == nil {
 183: 		apiKeyProvider = NewAPIKeyClientProvider()
 184: 	}

 187: 	if watcherFactory == nil {

 197: 	if accessManager == nil {
 198: 		accessManager = sdkaccess.NewManager()
 199: 	}
 200: 
 201: 	configaccess.Register(&b.cfg.SDKConfig)
 202: 	accessManager.SetProviders(sdkaccess.RegisteredProviders())
 203: 
 204: 	coreManager := b.coreManager
 205: 	if coreManager == nil {
 206: 		tokenStore := sdkAuth.GetTokenStore()
 207: 		if dirSetter, ok := tokenStore.(interface{ SetBaseDir(string) }); ok && b.cfg != nil {
 208: 			dirSetter.SetBaseDir(b.cfg.AuthDir)
 209: 		}
 210: 
 211: 		strategy := ""
 212: 		sessionAffinity := false
 213: 		sessionAffinityTTL := time.Hour
 214: 		if b.cfg != nil {
 215: 			strategy = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(b.cfg.Routing.Strategy))
 216: 			// Support both legacy ClaudeCodeSessionAffinity and new universal SessionAffinity
 217: 			sessionAffinity = b.cfg.Routing.SessionAffinity
 218: 			if ttlStr := strings.TrimSpace(b.cfg.Routing.SessionAffinityTTL); ttlStr != "" {
 219: 				if parsed, err := time.ParseDuration(ttlStr); err == nil && parsed > 0 {

 122: func (s *Service) ensureAuthUpdateQueue(ctx context.Context) {
 123: 	if s == nil {
 124: 		return
 125: 	}
 126: 	if s.authUpdates == nil {
 127: 		s.authUpdates = make(chan watcher.AuthUpdate, 256)
 128: 	}
 129: 	if s.authQueueStop != nil {
 130: 		return
 131: 	}
 132: 	queueCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
 133: 	s.authQueueStop = cancel
 134: 	go s.consumeAuthUpdates(queueCtx)
 135: }

 137: func (s *Service) consumeAuthUpdates(ctx context.Context) {
 138: 	ctx = coreauth.WithSkipPersist(ctx)
 139: 	for {
 140: 		select {
 141: 		case <-ctx.Done():
 142: 			return
 143: 		case update, ok := <-s.authUpdates:
 144: 			if !ok {
 145: 				return
 146: 			}
 147: 			s.handleAuthUpdate(ctx, update)
 148: 		labelDrain:
 149: 			for {
 150: 				select {
 151: 				case nextUpdate := <-s.authUpdates:
 152: 					s.handleAuthUpdate(ctx, nextUpdate)
 153: 				default:
 154: 					break labelDrain
 155: 				}
 156: 			}
 157: 		}
 158: 	}
 159: }

 161: func (s *Service) emitAuthUpdate(ctx context.Context, update watcher.AuthUpdate) {
 162: 	if s == nil {
 163: 		return
 164: 	}
 165: 	if ctx == nil {
 166: 		ctx = context.Background()
 167: 	}
 168: 	if s.watcher != nil && s.watcher.DispatchRuntimeAuthUpdate(update) {
 169: 		return
 170: 	}
 171: 	if s.authUpdates != nil {
 172: 		select {
 173: 		case s.authUpdates <- update:
 174: 			return
 175: 		default:
 176: 			log.Debugf("auth update queue saturated, applying inline action=%v id=%s", update.Action, update.ID)
 177: 		}
 178: 	}
 179: 	s.handleAuthUpdate(ctx, update)
 180: }
 181: 
 182: func (s *Service) handleAuthUpdate(ctx context.Context, update watcher.AuthUpdate) {
 183: 	if s == nil {
 184: 		return
 185: 	}
 186: 	s.cfgMu.RLock()
 187: 	cfg := s.cfg
 188: 	s.cfgMu.RUnlock()
 189: 	if cfg == nil || s.coreManager == nil {
 190: 		return
 191: 	}
 192: 	switch update.Action {
 193: 	case watcher.AuthUpdateActionAdd, watcher.AuthUpdateActionModify:
 194: 		if update.Auth == nil || update.Auth.ID == "" {
 195: 			return
 196: 		}
 197: 		s.applyCoreAuthAddOrUpdate(ctx, update.Auth)
 198: 	case watcher.AuthUpdateActionDelete:
 199: 		id := update.ID
 200: 		if id == "" && update.Auth != nil {
 201: 			id = update.Auth.ID
 202: 		}
 203: 		if id == "" {
 204: 			return
 205: 		}
 206: 		s.applyCoreAuthRemoval(ctx, id)
 207: 	default:
 208: 		log.Debugf("received unknown auth update action: %v", update.Action)
 209: 	}
 210: }

 230: func (s *Service) wsOnConnected(channelID string) {
 231: 	if s == nil || channelID == "" {
 232: 		return
 233: 	}
 234: 	if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(channelID), "aistudio-") {
 235: 		return
 236: 	}
 237: 	if s.coreManager != nil {
 238: 		if existing, ok := s.coreManager.GetByID(channelID); ok && existing != nil {
 239: 			if !existing.Disabled && existing.Status == coreauth.StatusActive {
 240: 				return
 241: 			}
 242: 		}
 243: 	}
 244: 	now := time.Now().UTC()
 245: 	auth := &coreauth.Auth{
 246: 		ID:         channelID,  // keep channel identifier as ID
 247: 		Provider:   "aistudio", // logical provider for switch routing
 248: 		Label:      channelID,  // display original channel id
 249: 		Status:     coreauth.StatusActive,
 250: 		CreatedAt:  now,
 251: 		UpdatedAt:  now,
 252: 		Attributes: map[string]string{"runtime_only": "true"},
 253: 		Metadata:   map[string]any{"email": channelID}, // metadata drives logging and usage tracking
 254: 	}
 255: 	log.Infof("websocket provider connected: %s", channelID)
 256: 	s.emitAuthUpdate(context.Background(), watcher.AuthUpdate{
 257: 		Action: watcher.AuthUpdateActionAdd,
 258: 		ID:     auth.ID,
 259: 		Auth:   auth,
 260: 	})
 261: }

 263: func (s *Service) wsOnDisconnected(channelID string, reason error) {
 264: 	if s == nil || channelID == "" {
 265: 		return
 266: 	}
 267: 	if reason != nil {
 268: 		if strings.Contains(reason.Error(), "replaced by new connection") {
 269: 			log.Infof("websocket provider replaced: %s", channelID)
 270: 			return
 271: 		}
 272: 		log.Warnf("websocket provider disconnected: %s (%v)", channelID, reason)
 273: 	} else {
 274: 		log.Infof("websocket provider disconnected: %s", channelID)
 275: 	}
 276: 	ctx := context.Background()
 277: 	s.emitAuthUpdate(ctx, watcher.AuthUpdate{
 278: 		Action: watcher.AuthUpdateActionDelete,
 279: 		ID:     channelID,
 280: 	})
 281: }

 283: func (s *Service) applyCoreAuthAddOrUpdate(ctx context.Context, auth *coreauth.Auth) {
 284: 	if s == nil || s.coreManager == nil || auth == nil || auth.ID == "" {
 285: 		return
 286: 	}
 287: 	auth = auth.Clone()
 288: 	s.ensureExecutorsForAuth(auth)
 289: 
 290: 	// IMPORTANT: Update coreManager FIRST, before model registration.
 291: 	// This ensures that configuration changes (proxy_url, prefix, etc.) take effect
 292: 	// immediately for API calls, rather than waiting for model registration to complete.
 293: 	op := "register"
 294: 	var err error
 295: 	if existing, ok := s.coreManager.GetByID(auth.ID); ok {
 296: 		auth.CreatedAt = existing.CreatedAt
 297: 		if !existing.Disabled && existing.Status != coreauth.StatusDisabled && !auth.Disabled && auth.Status != coreauth.StatusDisabled {
 298: 			auth.LastRefreshedAt = existing.LastRefreshedAt
 299: 			auth.NextRefreshAfter = existing.NextRefreshAfter
 300: 			if len(auth.ModelStates) == 0 && len(existing.ModelStates) > 0 {
 301: 				auth.ModelStates = existing.ModelStates
 302: 			}
 303: 		}
 304: 		op = "update"
 305: 		_, err = s.coreManager.Update(ctx, auth)
 306: 	} else {
 307: 		_, err = s.coreManager.Register(ctx, auth)
 308: 	}
 309: 	if err != nil {
 310: 		log.Errorf("failed to %s auth %s: %v", op, auth.ID, err)
 311: 		current, ok := s.coreManager.GetByID(auth.ID)
 312: 		if !ok || current.Disabled {
 313: 			GlobalModelRegistry().UnregisterClient(auth.ID)
 314: 			return
 315: 		}
 316: 		auth = current
 317: 	}
 318: 
 319: 	// Register models after auth is updated in coreManager.
 320: 	// This operation may block on network calls, but the auth configuration
 321: 	// is already effective at this point.
 322: 	s.registerModelsForAuth(auth)
 323: 	s.coreManager.ReconcileRegistryModelStates(ctx, auth.ID)
 324: 
 325: 	// Refresh the scheduler entry so that the auth's supportedModelSet is rebuilt
 326: 	// from the now-populated global model registry. Without this, newly added auths
 327: 	// have an empty supportedModelSet (because Register/Update upserts into the
 328: 	// scheduler before registerModelsForAuth runs) and are invisible to the scheduler.
 329: 	s.coreManager.RefreshSchedulerEntry(auth.ID)
 330: }

 332: func (s *Service) applyCoreAuthRemoval(ctx context.Context, id string) {
 333: 	if s == nil || id == "" {
 334: 		return
 335: 	}
 336: 	if s.coreManager == nil {
 337: 		return
 338: 	}
 339: 	GlobalModelRegistry().UnregisterClient(id)
 340: 	if existing, ok := s.coreManager.GetByID(id); ok && existing != nil {
 341: 		existing.Disabled = true
 342: 		existing.Status = coreauth.StatusDisabled
 343: 		if _, err := s.coreManager.Update(ctx, existing); err != nil {
 344: 			log.Errorf("failed to disable auth %s: %v", id, err)
 345: 		}
 346: 		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(existing.Provider), "codex") {
 347: 			executor.CloseCodexWebsocketSessionsForAuthID(existing.ID, "auth_removed")
 348: 			s.ensureExecutorsForAuth(existing)
 349: 		}
 350: 	}
 351: }

 361: func openAICompatInfoFromAuth(a *coreauth.Auth) (providerKey string, compatName string, ok bool) {
 362: 	if a == nil {
 363: 		return "", "", false
 364: 	}
 365: 	if len(a.Attributes) > 0 {
 366: 		providerKey = strings.TrimSpace(a.Attributes["provider_key"])
 367: 		compatName = strings.TrimSpace(a.Attributes["compat_name"])
 368: 		if compatName != "" {
 369: 			if providerKey == "" {
 370: 				providerKey = compatName
 371: 			}
 372: 			return strings.ToLower(providerKey), compatName, true
 373: 		}
 374: 	}
 375: 	if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(a.Provider), "openai-compatibility") {
 376: 		return "openai-compatibility", strings.TrimSpace(a.Label), true
 377: 	}
 378: 	return "", "", false
 379: }

 385: func (s *Service) ensureExecutorsForAuthWithMode(a *coreauth.Auth, forceReplace bool) {
 386: 	if s == nil || s.coreManager == nil || a == nil {
 387: 		return
 388: 	}
 389: 	if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(a.Provider), "codex") {
 390: 		if !forceReplace {
 391: 			existingExecutor, hasExecutor := s.coreManager.Executor("codex")
 392: 			if hasExecutor {
 393: 				_, isCodexAutoExecutor := existingExecutor.(*executor.CodexAutoExecutor)
 394: 				if isCodexAutoExecutor {
 395: 					return
 396: 				}
 397: 			}
 398: 		}
 399: 		s.coreManager.RegisterExecutor(executor.NewCodexAutoExecutor(s.cfg))
 400: 		return
 401: 	}
 402: 	// Skip disabled auth entries when (re)binding executors.
 403: 	// Disabled auths can linger during config reloads (e.g., removed OpenAI-compat entries)
 404: 	// and must not override active provider executors.
 405: 	if a.Disabled {
 406: 		return
 407: 	}
 408: 	if compatProviderKey, _, isCompat := openAICompatInfoFromAuth(a); isCompat {
 409: 		if compatProviderKey == "" {
 410: 			compatProviderKey = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(a.Provider))
 411: 		}
 412: 		if compatProviderKey == "" {
 413: 			compatProviderKey = "openai-compatibility"
 414: 		}
 415: 		s.coreManager.RegisterExecutor(executor.NewOpenAICompatExecutor(compatProviderKey, s.cfg))
 416: 		return
 417: 	}
 418: 	switch strings.ToLower(a.Provider) {
 419: 	case "gemini":
 420: 		s.coreManager.RegisterExecutor(executor.NewGeminiExecutor(s.cfg))
 421: 	case "vertex":
 422: 		s.coreManager.RegisterExecutor(executor.NewGeminiVertexExecutor(s.cfg))
 423: 	case "gemini-cli":
 424: 		s.coreManager.RegisterExecutor(executor.NewGeminiCLIExecutor(s.cfg))
 425: 	case "aistudio":
 426: 		if s.wsGateway != nil {
 427: 			s.coreManager.RegisterExecutor(executor.NewAIStudioExecutor(s.cfg, a.ID, s.wsGateway))
 428: 		}
 429: 		return
 430: 	case "antigravity":
 431: 		s.coreManager.RegisterExecutor(executor.NewAntigravityExecutor(s.cfg))
 432: 	case "claude":
 433: 		s.coreManager.RegisterExecutor(executor.NewClaudeExecutor(s.cfg))
 434: 	case "kimi":
 435: 		s.coreManager.RegisterExecutor(executor.NewKimiExecutor(s.cfg))
 436: 	default:
 437: 		providerKey := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(a.Provider))
 438: 		if providerKey == "" {
 439: 			providerKey = "openai-compatibility"
 440: 		}
 441: 		s.coreManager.RegisterExecutor(executor.NewOpenAICompatExecutor(providerKey, s.cfg))
 442: 	}
 443: }

 456: // rebindExecutors refreshes provider executors so they observe the latest configuration.
 457: func (s *Service) rebindExecutors() {
 458: 	if s == nil || s.coreManager == nil {
 459: 		return
 460: 	}
 461: 	auths := s.coreManager.List()
 462: 	reboundCodex := false
 463: 	for _, auth := range auths {
 464: 		if auth != nil && strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(auth.Provider), "codex") {
 465: 			if reboundCodex {
 466: 				continue
 467: 			}
 468: 			reboundCodex = true
 469: 		}
 470: 		s.ensureExecutorsForAuthWithMode(auth, true)

 474: func (s *Service) applyConfigUpdate(newCfg *config.Config) {
 475: 	if s == nil {
 476: 		return
 477: 	}
 478: 
 479: 	s.configUpdateMu.Lock()
 480: 	defer s.configUpdateMu.Unlock()
 481: 
 482: 	previousStrategy := ""
 483: 	var previousSessionAffinity bool
 484: 	var previousSessionAffinityTTL string
 485: 	s.cfgMu.RLock()
 486: 	if s.cfg != nil {
 487: 		previousStrategy = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(s.cfg.Routing.Strategy))
 488: 		previousSessionAffinity = s.cfg.Routing.SessionAffinity
 489: 		previousSessionAffinityTTL = s.cfg.Routing.SessionAffinityTTL
 490: 	}
 491: 	s.cfgMu.RUnlock()
 492: 
 493: 	if newCfg == nil {
 494: 		s.cfgMu.RLock()
 495: 		newCfg = s.cfg
 496: 		s.cfgMu.RUnlock()
 497: 	}
 498: 	if newCfg == nil {
 499: 		return
 500: 	}
 501: 
 502: 	nextStrategy := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(newCfg.Routing.Strategy))
 503: 	normalizeStrategy := func(strategy string) string {
 504: 		switch strategy {
 505: 		case "fill-first", "fillfirst", "ff":
 506: 			return "fill-first"
 507: 		default:
 508: 			return "round-robin"
 509: 		}
 510: 	}
 511: 	previousStrategy = normalizeStrategy(previousStrategy)
 512: 	nextStrategy = normalizeStrategy(nextStrategy)
 513: 
 514: 	nextSessionAffinity := newCfg.Routing.SessionAffinity
 515: 	nextSessionAffinityTTL := newCfg.Routing.SessionAffinityTTL
 516: 
 517: 	selectorChanged := previousStrategy != nextStrategy ||
 518: 		previousSessionAffinity != nextSessionAffinity ||
 519: 		previousSessionAffinityTTL != nextSessionAffinityTTL
 520: 
 521: 	if s.coreManager != nil && selectorChanged {
 522: 		var selector coreauth.Selector
 523: 		switch nextStrategy {
 524: 		case "fill-first":
 525: 			selector = &coreauth.FillFirstSelector{}
 526: 		default:
 527: 			selector = &coreauth.RoundRobinSelector{}
 528: 		}
 529: 
 530: 		if nextSessionAffinity {
 531: 			ttl := time.Hour
 532: 			if ttlStr := strings.TrimSpace(nextSessionAffinityTTL); ttlStr != "" {
 533: 				if parsed, err := time.ParseDuration(ttlStr); err == nil && parsed > 0 {
 534: 					ttl = parsed
 535: 				}
 536: 			}
 537: 			selector = coreauth.NewSessionAffinitySelectorWithConfig(coreauth.SessionAffinityConfig{
 538: 				Fallback: selector,
 539: 				TTL:      ttl,
 540: 			})
 541: 		}
 542: 
 543: 		s.coreManager.SetSelector(selector)
 544: 	}
 545: 
 546: 	s.applyRetryConfig(newCfg)
 547: 	s.applyPprofConfig(newCfg)
 548: 	if s.server != nil {
 549: 		s.server.UpdateClients(newCfg)
 550: 	}
 551: 	s.cfgMu.Lock()
 552: 	s.cfg = newCfg
 553: 	s.cfgMu.Unlock()
 554: 	if s.coreManager != nil {
 555: 		s.coreManager.SetConfig(newCfg)
 556: 		s.coreManager.SetOAuthModelAlias(newCfg.OAuthModelAlias)
 557: 	}
 558: 	s.rebindExecutors()
 559: }

 577: 	}

 579: 	// Register baseline executors so home-dispatched auth entries can execute without

 587: 	s.coreManager.RegisterExecutor(executor.NewAntigravityExecutor(s.cfg))
 588: 	s.coreManager.RegisterExecutor(executor.NewKimiExecutor(s.cfg))
 589: 	s.coreManager.RegisterExecutor(executor.NewOpenAICompatExecutor("openai-compatibility", s.cfg))
 590: }

 592: func (s *Service) applyHomeOverlay(remoteCfg *config.Config) {
 593: 	if s == nil || remoteCfg == nil {
 594: 		return
 595: 	}
 596: 
 597: 	s.cfgMu.RLock()
 598: 	baseCfg := s.cfg
 599: 	s.cfgMu.RUnlock()
 600: 	if baseCfg == nil {
 601: 		return
 602: 	}
 603: 
 604: 	merged := *remoteCfg
 605: 	merged.Host = baseCfg.Host
 606: 	merged.Port = baseCfg.Port
 607: 	merged.TLS = baseCfg.TLS
 608: 	merged.Home = baseCfg.Home
 609: 	forceHomeRuntimeConfig(&merged)
 610: 
 611: 	logHomeConfigChanges(baseCfg, &merged)
 612: 	s.applyConfigUpdate(&merged)

 615: func logHomeConfigChanges(oldCfg, newCfg *config.Config) {
 616: 	if oldCfg == nil || newCfg == nil || !newCfg.Home.Enabled || (!oldCfg.Debug && !newCfg.Debug) {
 617: 		return
 618: 	}
 619: 
 620: 	details := diff.BuildConfigChangeDetails(oldCfg, newCfg)
 621: 	if len(details) == 0 {
 622: 		return
 623: 	}
 624: 
 625: 	if newCfg.Debug && !log.IsLevelEnabled(log.DebugLevel) {
 626: 		util.SetLogLevel(newCfg)
 627: 	}
 628: 
 629: 	log.Debugf("home config changes detected:")
 630: 	for _, detail := range details {
 631: 		log.Debugf("  %s", detail)
 632: 	}
 633: }

 635: func (s *Service) startHomeUsageForwarder(ctx context.Context, client *home.Client) {
 636: 	if s == nil || client == nil {
 637: 		return
 638: 	}
 639: 	if ctx == nil {
 640: 		ctx = context.Background()
 641: 	}
 642: 
 643: 	sleep := func(d time.Duration) bool {
 644: 		if d <= 0 {
 645: 			return true
 646: 		}
 647: 		timer := time.NewTimer(d)
 648: 		defer timer.Stop()
 649: 		select {
 650: 		case <-ctx.Done():
 651: 			return false
 652: 		case <-timer.C:
 653: 			return true
 654: 		}
 655: 	}
 656: 
 657: 	go func() {
 658: 		for {
 659: 			select {
 660: 			case <-ctx.Done():
 661: 				return
 662: 			default:
 663: 			}
 664: 
 665: 			if !client.HeartbeatOK() {
 666: 				if !sleep(time.Second) {
 667: 					return
 668: 				}
 669: 				continue
 670: 			}
 671: 
 672: 			items := redisqueue.PopOldest(64)
 673: 			if len(items) == 0 {
 674: 				if !sleep(500 * time.Millisecond) {
 675: 					return
 676: 				}
 677: 				continue
 678: 			}
 679: 
 680: 			for i := range items {
 681: 				if errPush := client.LPushUsage(ctx, items[i]); errPush != nil {
 682: 					for j := i; j < len(items); j++ {
 683: 						redisqueue.Enqueue(items[j])
 684: 					}
 685: 					if !sleep(time.Second) {
 686: 						return
 687: 					}
 688: 					break
 689: 				}
 690: 			}
 691: 		}
 692: 	}()
 693: }

 695: func (s *Service) startHomeSubscriber(ctx context.Context) {

 698: 	}

 701: 	s.cfgMu.RUnlock()

 703: 		return
 704: 	}

 707: 		s.homeCancel()

 709: 	}

 738: // Run starts the service and blocks until the context is cancelled or the server stops.
 739: // It initializes all components including authentication, file watching, HTTP server,
 740: // and starts processing requests. The method blocks until the context is cancelled.
 741: //
 742: // Parameters:
 743: //   - ctx: The context for controlling the service lifecycle
 744: //
 745: // Returns:
 746: //   - error: An error if the service fails to start or run
 747: func (s *Service) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
 748: 	if s == nil {
 749: 		return fmt.Errorf("cliproxy: service is nil")
 750: 	}
 751: 	if ctx == nil {
 752: 		ctx = context.Background()
 753: 	}
 754: 
 755: 	usage.StartDefault(ctx)
 756: 	homeEnabled := s.cfg != nil && s.cfg.Home.Enabled
 757: 	if homeEnabled {
 758: 		forceHomeRuntimeConfig(s.cfg)
 759: 		redisqueue.SetUsageStatisticsEnabled(true)
 760: 	}
 761: 
 762: 	shutdownCtx, shutdownCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
 763: 	defer shutdownCancel()
 764: 	defer func() {
 765: 		if err := s.Shutdown(shutdownCtx); err != nil {
 766: 			log.Errorf("service shutdown returned error: %v", err)
 767: 		}
 768: 	}()
 769: 
 770: 	if !homeEnabled {
 771: 		if errEnsureAuthDir := s.ensureAuthDir(); errEnsureAuthDir != nil {
 772: 			return errEnsureAuthDir
 773: 		}
 774: 	}
 775: 
 776: 	s.applyRetryConfig(s.cfg)
 777: 
 778: 	if s.coreManager != nil && !homeEnabled {
 779: 		if errLoad := s.coreManager.Load(ctx); errLoad != nil {
 780: 			log.Warnf("failed to load auth store: %v", errLoad)
 781: 		}
 782: 	}
 783: 
 784: 	if !homeEnabled {
 785: 		tokenResult, err := s.tokenProvider.Load(ctx, s.cfg)
 786: 		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
 787: 			return err
 788: 		}
 789: 		if tokenResult == nil {
 790: 			tokenResult = &TokenClientResult{}
 791: 		}
 792: 
 793: 		apiKeyResult, err := s.apiKeyProvider.Load(ctx, s.cfg)
 794: 		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
 795: 			return err
 796: 		}
 797: 		if apiKeyResult == nil {
 798: 			apiKeyResult = &APIKeyClientResult{}
 799: 		}
 800: 	}
 801: 
 802: 	// legacy clients removed; no caches to refresh
 803: 
 804: 	// handlers no longer depend on legacy clients; pass nil slice initially
 805: 	s.server = api.NewServer(s.cfg, s.coreManager, s.accessManager, s.configPath, s.serverOptions...)
 806: 
 807: 	if s.authManager == nil {
 808: 		s.authManager = newDefaultAuthManager()
 809: 	}
 810: 
 811: 	if homeEnabled {
 812: 		s.startHomeSubscriber(ctx)
 813: 	}
 814: 
 815: 	s.ensureWebsocketGateway()
 816: 	if s.server != nil && s.wsGateway != nil {
 817: 		s.server.AttachWebsocketRoute(s.wsGateway.Path(), s.wsGateway.Handler())
 818: 		s.server.SetWebsocketAuthChangeHandler(func(oldEnabled, newEnabled bool) {
 819: 			if oldEnabled == newEnabled {
 820: 				return
 821: 			}
 822: 			if !oldEnabled && newEnabled {
 823: 				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
 824: 				defer cancel()
 825: 				if errStop := s.wsGateway.Stop(ctx); errStop != nil {
 826: 					log.Warnf("failed to reset websocket connections after ws-auth change %t -> %t: %v", oldEnabled, newEnabled, errStop)
 827: 					return
 828: 				}
 829: 				log.Debugf("ws-auth enabled; existing websocket sessions terminated to enforce authentication")
 830: 				return
 831: 			}
 832: 			log.Debugf("ws-auth disabled; existing websocket sessions remain connected")
 833: 		})
 834: 	}
 835: 
 836: 	if homeEnabled {
 837: 		s.registerHomeExecutors()
 838: 		// Home mode does not expose in-process Redis RESP usage output; usage is forwarded to home instead.
 839: 		redisqueue.SetEnabled(true)
 840: 	}
 841: 
 842: 	if s.hooks.OnBeforeStart != nil {
 843: 		s.hooks.OnBeforeStart(s.cfg)
 844: 	}
 845: 
 846: 	// Register callback for startup and periodic model catalog refresh.
 847: 	// When remote model definitions change, re-register models for affected providers.
 848: 	// This intentionally rebuilds per-auth model availability from the latest catalog
 849: 	// snapshot instead of preserving prior registry suppression state.
 850: 	registry.SetModelRefreshCallback(func(changedProviders []string) {
 851: 		if s == nil || s.coreManager == nil || len(changedProviders) == 0 {
 852: 			return
 853: 		}
 854: 
 855: 		providerSet := make(map[string]bool, len(changedProviders))
 856: 		for _, p := range changedProviders {
 857: 			providerSet[strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(p))] = true
 858: 		}
 859: 
 860: 		auths := s.coreManager.List()
 861: 		refreshed := 0
 862: 		for _, item := range auths {
 863: 			if item == nil || item.ID == "" {
 864: 				continue
 865: 			}
 866: 			auth, ok := s.coreManager.GetByID(item.ID)
 867: 			if !ok || auth == nil || auth.Disabled {
 868: 				continue
 869: 			}
 870: 			provider := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(auth.Provider))
 871: 			if !providerSet[provider] {
 872: 				continue
 873: 			}
 874: 			if s.refreshModelRegistrationForAuth(auth) {
 875: 				refreshed++
 876: 			}
 877: 		}
 878: 
 879: 		if refreshed > 0 {
 880: 			log.Infof("re-registered models for %d auth(s) due to model catalog changes: %v", refreshed, changedProviders)
 881: 		}
 882: 	})
 883: 
 884: 	s.serverErr = make(chan error, 1)
 885: 	go func() {
 886: 		if errStart := s.server.Start(); errStart != nil {
 887: 			s.serverErr <- errStart
 888: 		} else {
 889: 			s.serverErr <- nil
 890: 		}
 891: 	}()
 892: 
 893: 	time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
 894: 	fmt.Printf("API server started successfully on: %s:%d\n", s.cfg.Host, s.cfg.Port)
 895: 
 896: 	s.applyPprofConfig(s.cfg)
 897: 
 898: 	if s.hooks.OnAfterStart != nil {
 899: 		s.hooks.OnAfterStart(s)
 900: 	}
 901: 
 902: 	if !homeEnabled {
 903: 		var watcherWrapper *WatcherWrapper
 904: 		reloadCallback := func(newCfg *config.Config) { s.applyConfigUpdate(newCfg) }
 905: 
 906: 		watcherWrapper, errCreate := s.watcherFactory(s.configPath, s.cfg.AuthDir, reloadCallback)
 907: 		if errCreate != nil {
 908: 			return fmt.Errorf("cliproxy: failed to create watcher: %w", errCreate)
 909: 		}
 910: 		s.watcher = watcherWrapper
 911: 		s.ensureAuthUpdateQueue(ctx)
 912: 		if s.authUpdates != nil {
 913: 			watcherWrapper.SetAuthUpdateQueue(s.authUpdates)
 914: 		}
 915: 		watcherWrapper.SetConfig(s.cfg)
 916: 
 917: 		watcherCtx, watcherCancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
 918: 		s.watcherCancel = watcherCancel
 919: 		if errStart := watcherWrapper.Start(watcherCtx); errStart != nil {
 920: 			return fmt.Errorf("cliproxy: failed to start watcher: %w", errStart)
 921: 		}
 922: 		log.Info("file watcher started for config and auth directory changes")
 923: 	}
 924: 
 925: 	// Prefer core auth manager auto refresh if available.
 926: 	if s.coreManager != nil && !homeEnabled {
 927: 		interval := 15 * time.Minute
 928: 		s.coreManager.StartAutoRefresh(context.Background(), interval)
 929: 		log.Infof("core auth auto-refresh started (interval=%s)", interval)
 930: 	}
 931: 
 932: 	select {
 933: 	case <-ctx.Done():
 934: 		log.Debug("service context cancelled, shutting down...")
 935: 		return ctx.Err()
 936: 	case errServer := <-s.serverErr:
 937: 		return errServer
 938: 	}
 939: }
 940: 
 941: // Shutdown gracefully stops background workers and the HTTP server.
 942: // It ensures all resources are properly cleaned up and connections are closed.
 943: // The shutdown is idempotent and can be called multiple times safely.
 944: //
 945: // Parameters:
 946: //   - ctx: The context for controlling the shutdown timeout
 947: //
 948: // Returns:
 949: //   - error: An error if shutdown fails
 950: func (s *Service) Shutdown(ctx context.Context) error {
 951: 	if s == nil {
 952: 		return nil
 953: 	}
 954: 	var shutdownErr error
 955: 	s.shutdownOnce.Do(func() {
 956: 		if ctx == nil {
 957: 			ctx = context.Background()
 958: 		}
 959: 
 960: 		if s.homeCancel != nil {
 961: 			s.homeCancel()
 962: 			s.homeCancel = nil
 963: 		}
 964: 		if s.homeClient != nil {
 965: 			s.homeClient.Close()
 966: 			s.homeClient = nil
 967: 		}
 968: 		home.ClearCurrent()
 969: 
 970: 		// legacy refresh loop removed; only stopping core auth manager below
 971: 
 972: 		if s.watcherCancel != nil {
 973: 			s.watcherCancel()
 974: 		}
 975: 		if s.coreManager != nil {
 976: 			s.coreManager.StopAutoRefresh()
 977: 		}
 978: 		if s.watcher != nil {
 979: 			if err := s.watcher.Stop(); err != nil {
 980: 				log.Errorf("failed to stop file watcher: %v", err)
 981: 				shutdownErr = err
 982: 			}
 983: 		}
 984: 		if s.wsGateway != nil {
 985: 			if err := s.wsGateway.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
 986: 				log.Errorf("failed to stop websocket gateway: %v", err)
 987: 				if shutdownErr == nil {
 988: 					shutdownErr = err
 989: 				}
 990: 			}
 991: 		}
 992: 		if s.authQueueStop != nil {
 993: 			s.authQueueStop()
 994: 			s.authQueueStop = nil
 995: 		}
 996: 
 997: 		if errShutdownPprof := s.shutdownPprof(ctx); errShutdownPprof != nil {
 998: 			log.Errorf("failed to stop pprof server: %v", errShutdownPprof)
 999: 			if shutdownErr == nil {
1000: 				shutdownErr = errShutdownPprof
1001: 			}
1002: 		}
1003: 
1004: 		// no legacy clients to persist
1005: 
1006: 		if s.server != nil {
1007: 			shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 30*time.Second)
1008: 			defer cancel()
1009: 			if err := s.server.Stop(shutdownCtx); err != nil {
1010: 				log.Errorf("error stopping API server: %v", err)
1011: 				if shutdownErr == nil {
1012: 					shutdownErr = err
1013: 				}
1014: 			}
1015: 		}
1016: 
1017: 		usage.StopDefault()
1018: 	})
1019: 	return shutdownErr
1020: }

1022: func (s *Service) ensureAuthDir() error {
1023: 	info, err := os.Stat(s.cfg.AuthDir)
1024: 	if err != nil {
1025: 		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
1026: 			if mkErr := os.MkdirAll(s.cfg.AuthDir, 0o755); mkErr != nil {
1027: 				return fmt.Errorf("cliproxy: failed to create auth directory %s: %w", s.cfg.AuthDir, mkErr)
1028: 			}
1029: 			log.Infof("created missing auth directory: %s", s.cfg.AuthDir)
1030: 			return nil
1031: 		}
1032: 		return fmt.Errorf("cliproxy: error checking auth directory %s: %w", s.cfg.AuthDir, err)
1033: 	}
1034: 	if !info.IsDir() {
1035: 		return fmt.Errorf("cliproxy: auth path exists but is not a directory: %s", s.cfg.AuthDir)
1036: 	}
1037: 	return nil
1038: }

1040: // registerModelsForAuth (re)binds provider models in the global registry using the core auth ID as client identifier.
1041: func (s *Service) registerModelsForAuth(a *coreauth.Auth) {
1042: 	if a == nil || a.ID == "" {
1043: 		return
1044: 	}
1045: 	if a.Disabled {
1046: 		GlobalModelRegistry().UnregisterClient(a.ID)
1047: 		return
1048: 	}
1049: 	authKind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(a.Attributes["auth_kind"]))
1050: 	if authKind == "" {
1051: 		if kind, _ := a.AccountInfo(); strings.EqualFold(kind, "api_key") {
1052: 			authKind = "apikey"
1053: 		}
1054: 	}
1055: 	if a.Attributes != nil {
1056: 		if v := strings.TrimSpace(a.Attributes["gemini_virtual_primary"]); strings.EqualFold(v, "true") {
1057: 			GlobalModelRegistry().UnregisterClient(a.ID)
1058: 			return
1059: 		}
1060: 	}
1061: 	// Unregister legacy client ID (if present) to avoid double counting
1062: 	if a.Runtime != nil {
1063: 		if idGetter, ok := a.Runtime.(interface{ GetClientID() string }); ok {
1064: 			if rid := idGetter.GetClientID(); rid != "" && rid != a.ID {
1065: 				GlobalModelRegistry().UnregisterClient(rid)
1066: 			}
1067: 		}
1068: 	}
1069: 	provider := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(a.Provider))
1070: 	compatProviderKey, compatDisplayName, compatDetected := openAICompatInfoFromAuth(a)
1071: 	if compatDetected {
1072: 		provider = "openai-compatibility"
1073: 	}
1074: 	excluded := s.oauthExcludedModels(provider, authKind)
1075: 	// The synthesizer pre-merges per-account and global exclusions into the "excluded_models" attribute.
1076: 	// If this attribute is present, it represents the complete list of exclusions and overrides the global config.
1077: 	if a.Attributes != nil {
1078: 		if val, ok := a.Attributes["excluded_models"]; ok && strings.TrimSpace(val) != "" {
1079: 			excluded = strings.Split(val, ",")
1080: 		}
1081: 	}
1082: 	var models []*ModelInfo
1083: 	switch provider {
1084: 	case "gemini":
1085: 		models = registry.GetGeminiModels()
1086: 		if entry := s.resolveConfigGeminiKey(a); entry != nil {
1087: 			if len(entry.Models) > 0 {
1088: 				models = buildGeminiConfigModels(entry)
1089: 			}
1090: 			if authKind == "apikey" {
1091: 				excluded = entry.ExcludedModels
1092: 			}
1093: 		}
1094: 		models = applyExcludedModels(models, excluded)
1095: 	case "vertex":
1096: 		// Vertex AI Gemini supports the same model identifiers as Gemini.
1097: 		models = registry.GetGeminiVertexModels()
1098: 		if entry := s.resolveConfigVertexCompatKey(a); entry != nil {
1099: 			if len(entry.Models) > 0 {
1100: 				models = buildVertexCompatConfigModels(entry)
1101: 			}
1102: 			if authKind == "apikey" {
1103: 				excluded = entry.ExcludedModels
1104: 			}
1105: 		}
1106: 		models = applyExcludedModels(models, excluded)
1107: 	case "gemini-cli":
1108: 		models = registry.GetGeminiCLIModels()
1109: 		models = applyExcludedModels(models, excluded)
1110: 	case "aistudio":
1111: 		models = registry.GetAIStudioModels()
1112: 		models = applyExcludedModels(models, excluded)
1113: 	case "antigravity":
1114: 		models = registry.GetAntigravityModels()
1115: 		models = applyExcludedModels(models, excluded)
1116: 	case "claude":
1117: 		models = registry.GetClaudeModels()
1118: 		if entry := s.resolveConfigClaudeKey(a); entry != nil {
1119: 			if len(entry.Models) > 0 {
1120: 				models = buildClaudeConfigModels(entry)
1121: 			}
1122: 			if authKind == "apikey" {
1123: 				excluded = entry.ExcludedModels
1124: 			}
1125: 		}
1126: 		models = applyExcludedModels(models, excluded)
1127: 	case "codex":
1128: 		codexPlanType := ""
1129: 		if a.Attributes != nil {
1130: 			codexPlanType = strings.TrimSpace(a.Attributes["plan_type"])
1131: 		}
1132: 		switch strings.ToLower(codexPlanType) {
1133: 		case "pro":
1134: 			models = registry.GetCodexProModels()
1135: 		case "plus":
1136: 			models = registry.GetCodexPlusModels()
1137: 		case "team", "business", "go":
1138: 			models = registry.GetCodexTeamModels()
1139: 		case "free":
1140: 			models = registry.GetCodexFreeModels()
1141: 		default:
1142: 			models = registry.GetCodexProModels()
1143: 		}
1144: 		if entry := s.resolveConfigCodexKey(a); entry != nil {
1145: 			if len(entry.Models) > 0 {
1146: 				models = buildCodexConfigModels(entry)
1147: 			}
1148: 			if authKind == "apikey" {
1149: 				excluded = entry.ExcludedModels
1150: 			}
1151: 		}
1152: 		models = applyExcludedModels(models, excluded)
1153: 	case "kimi":
1154: 		models = registry.GetKimiModels()
1155: 		models = applyExcludedModels(models, excluded)
1156: 	default:
1157: 		// Handle OpenAI-compatibility providers by name using config
1158: 		if s.cfg != nil {
1159: 			providerKey := provider
1160: 			compatName := strings.TrimSpace(a.Provider)
1161: 			isCompatAuth := false
1162: 			if compatDetected {
1163: 				if compatProviderKey != "" {
1164: 					providerKey = compatProviderKey
1165: 				}
1166: 				if compatDisplayName != "" {
1167: 					compatName = compatDisplayName
1168: 				}
1169: 				isCompatAuth = true
1170: 			}
1171: 			if strings.EqualFold(providerKey, "openai-compatibility") {
1172: 				isCompatAuth = true
1173: 				if a.Attributes != nil {
1174: 					if v := strings.TrimSpace(a.Attributes["compat_name"]); v != "" {
1175: 						compatName = v
1176: 					}
1177: 					if v := strings.TrimSpace(a.Attributes["provider_key"]); v != "" {
1178: 						providerKey = strings.ToLower(v)
1179: 						isCompatAuth = true
1180: 					}
1181: 				}
1182: 				if providerKey == "openai-compatibility" && compatName != "" {
1183: 					providerKey = strings.ToLower(compatName)
1184: 				}
1185: 			} else if a.Attributes != nil {
1186: 				if v := strings.TrimSpace(a.Attributes["compat_name"]); v != "" {
1187: 					compatName = v
1188: 					isCompatAuth = true
1189: 				}
1190: 				if v := strings.TrimSpace(a.Attributes["provider_key"]); v != "" {
1191: 					providerKey = strings.ToLower(v)
1192: 					isCompatAuth = true
1193: 				}
1194: 			}
1195: 			for i := range s.cfg.OpenAICompatibility {
1196: 				compat := &s.cfg.OpenAICompatibility[i]
1197: 				if compat.Disabled {
1198: 					continue
1199: 				}
1200: 				if strings.EqualFold(compat.Name, compatName) {
1201: 					isCompatAuth = true
1202: 					// Convert compatibility models to registry models
1203: 					ms := make([]*ModelInfo, 0, len(compat.Models))
1204: 					for j := range compat.Models {
1205: 						m := compat.Models[j]
1206: 						// Use alias as model ID, fallback to name if alias is empty
1207: 						modelID := m.Alias
1208: 						if modelID == "" {
1209: 							modelID = m.Name
1210: 						}
1211: 						thinking := m.Thinking
1212: 						if thinking == nil {
1213: 							thinking = &registry.ThinkingSupport{Levels: []string{"low", "medium", "high"}}
1214: 						}
1215: 						ms = append(ms, &ModelInfo{
1216: 							ID:          modelID,
1217: 							Object:      "model",
1218: 							Created:     time.Now().Unix(),
1219: 							OwnedBy:     compat.Name,
1220: 							Type:        "openai-compatibility",
1221: 							DisplayName: modelID,
1222: 							UserDefined: false,
1223: 							Thinking:    thinking,
1224: 						})
1225: 					}
1226: 					// Register and return
1227: 					if len(ms) > 0 {
1228: 						if providerKey == "" {
1229: 							providerKey = "openai-compatibility"
1230: 						}
1231: 						s.registerResolvedModelsForAuth(a, providerKey, applyModelPrefixes(ms, a.Prefix, s.cfg.ForceModelPrefix))
1232: 					} else {
1233: 						// Ensure stale registrations are cleared when model list becomes empty.
1234: 						GlobalModelRegistry().UnregisterClient(a.ID)
1235: 					}
1236: 					return
1237: 				}
1238: 			}
1239: 			if isCompatAuth {
1240: 				// No matching provider found or models removed entirely; drop any prior registration.
1241: 				GlobalModelRegistry().UnregisterClient(a.ID)
1242: 				return
1243: 			}
1244: 		}
1245: 	}
1246: 	models = applyOAuthModelAlias(s.cfg, provider, authKind, models)
1247: 	if len(models) > 0 {
1248: 		key := provider
1249: 		if key == "" {
1250: 			key = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(a.Provider))
1251: 		}
1252: 		s.registerResolvedModelsForAuth(a, key, applyModelPrefixes(models, a.Prefix, s.cfg != nil && s.cfg.ForceModelPrefix))
1253: 		return
1254: 	}
1255: 
1256: 	GlobalModelRegistry().UnregisterClient(a.ID)
1257: }
1258: 
1259: // refreshModelRegistrationForAuth re-applies the latest model registration for
1260: // one auth and reconciles any concurrent auth changes that race with the
1261: // refresh. Callers are expected to pre-filter provider membership.
1262: //
1263: // Re-registration is deliberate: registry cooldown/suspension state is treated
1264: // as part of the previous registration snapshot and is cleared when the auth is
1265: // rebound to the refreshed model catalog.
1266: func (s *Service) refreshModelRegistrationForAuth(current *coreauth.Auth) bool {
1267: 	if s == nil || s.coreManager == nil || current == nil || current.ID == "" {
1268: 		return false
1269: 	}
1270: 
1271: 	if !current.Disabled {
1272: 		s.ensureExecutorsForAuth(current)
1273: 	}
1274: 	s.registerModelsForAuth(current)
1275: 	s.coreManager.ReconcileRegistryModelStates(context.Background(), current.ID)
1276: 
1277: 	latest, ok := s.latestAuthForModelRegistration(current.ID)
1278: 	if !ok || latest.Disabled {
1279: 		GlobalModelRegistry().UnregisterClient(current.ID)
1280: 		s.coreManager.RefreshSchedulerEntry(current.ID)
1281: 		return false
1282: 	}
1283: 
1284: 	// Re-apply the latest auth snapshot so concurrent auth updates cannot leave
1285: 	// stale model registrations behind. This may duplicate registration work when
1286: 	// no auth fields changed, but keeps the refresh path simple and correct.
1287: 	s.ensureExecutorsForAuth(latest)
1288: 	s.registerModelsForAuth(latest)
1289: 	s.coreManager.ReconcileRegistryModelStates(context.Background(), latest.ID)
1290: 	s.coreManager.RefreshSchedulerEntry(current.ID)
1291: 	return true
1292: }
1293: 
1294: // latestAuthForModelRegistration returns the latest auth snapshot regardless of
1295: // provider membership. Callers use this after a registration attempt to restore
1296: // whichever state currently owns the client ID in the global registry.
1297: func (s *Service) latestAuthForModelRegistration(authID string) (*coreauth.Auth, bool) {
1298: 	if s == nil || s.coreManager == nil || authID == "" {
1299: 		return nil, false
1300: 	}
1301: 	auth, ok := s.coreManager.GetByID(authID)
1302: 	if !ok || auth == nil || auth.ID == "" {
1303: 		return nil, false
1304: 	}
1305: 	return auth, true
1306: }

1446: func applyExcludedModels(models []*ModelInfo, excluded []string) []*ModelInfo {
1447: 	if len(models) == 0 || len(excluded) == 0 {
1448: 		return models
1449: 	}
1450: 
1451: 	patterns := make([]string, 0, len(excluded))
1452: 	for _, item := range excluded {
1453: 		if trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(item); trimmed != "" {
1454: 			patterns = append(patterns, strings.ToLower(trimmed))
1455: 		}
1456: 	}
1457: 	if len(patterns) == 0 {
1458: 		return models
1459: 	}
1460: 
1461: 	filtered := make([]*ModelInfo, 0, len(models))
1462: 	for _, model := range models {
1463: 		if model == nil {
1464: 			continue
1465: 		}
1466: 		modelID := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(model.ID))
1467: 		blocked := false
1468: 		for _, pattern := range patterns {
1469: 			if matchWildcard(pattern, modelID) {
1470: 				blocked = true
1471: 				break
1472: 			}
1473: 		}
1474: 		if !blocked {
1475: 			filtered = append(filtered, model)
1476: 		}
1477: 	}
1478: 	return filtered
1479: }

1481: func applyModelPrefixes(models []*ModelInfo, prefix string, forceModelPrefix bool) []*ModelInfo {
1482: 	trimmedPrefix := strings.TrimSpace(prefix)
1483: 	if trimmedPrefix == "" || len(models) == 0 {
1484: 		return models
1485: 	}
1486: 
1487: 	out := make([]*ModelInfo, 0, len(models)*2)
1488: 	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(models)*2)
1489: 
1490: 	addModel := func(model *ModelInfo) {
1491: 		if model == nil {
1492: 			return
1493: 		}
1494: 		id := strings.TrimSpace(model.ID)
1495: 		if id == "" {
1496: 			return
1497: 		}
1498: 		if _, exists := seen[id]; exists {
1499: 			return
1500: 		}
1501: 		seen[id] = struct{}{}
1502: 		out = append(out, model)
1503: 	}
1504: 
1505: 	for _, model := range models {
1506: 		if model == nil {
1507: 			continue
1508: 		}
1509: 		baseID := strings.TrimSpace(model.ID)
1510: 		if baseID == "" {
1511: 			continue
1512: 		}
1513: 		if !forceModelPrefix || trimmedPrefix == baseID {
1514: 			addModel(model)
1515: 		}
1516: 		clone := *model
1517: 		clone.ID = trimmedPrefix + "/" + baseID
1518: 		addModel(&clone)
1519: 	}
1520: 	return out
1521: }
1522: 
1523: // matchWildcard performs case-insensitive wildcard matching where '*' matches any substring.
1524: func matchWildcard(pattern, value string) bool {
1525: 	if pattern == "" {
1526: 		return false
1527: 	}
1528: 
1529: 	// Fast path for exact match (no wildcard present).
1530: 	if !strings.Contains(pattern, "*") {
1531: 		return pattern == value
1532: 	}
1533: 
1534: 	parts := strings.Split(pattern, "*")
1535: 	// Handle prefix.
1536: 	if prefix := parts[0]; prefix != "" {
1537: 		if !strings.HasPrefix(value, prefix) {
1538: 			return false
1539: 		}
1540: 		value = value[len(prefix):]
1541: 	}
1542: 
1543: 	// Handle suffix.
1544: 	if suffix := parts[len(parts)-1]; suffix != "" {
1545: 		if !strings.HasSuffix(value, suffix) {
1546: 			return false
1547: 		}
1548: 		value = value[:len(value)-len(suffix)]
1549: 	}
1550: 
1551: 	// Handle middle segments in order.
1552: 	for i := 1; i < len(parts)-1; i++ {
1553: 		segment := parts[i]
1554: 		if segment == "" {
1555: 			continue
1556: 		}
1557: 		idx := strings.Index(value, segment)
1558: 		if idx < 0 {
1559: 			return false
1560: 		}
1561: 		value = value[idx+len(segment):]
1562: 	}
1563: 
1564: 	return true
1565: }

1568: 	GetName() string
1569: 	GetAlias() string

1572: func buildConfigModels[T modelEntry](models []T, ownedBy, modelType string) []*ModelInfo {
1573: 	if len(models) == 0 {
1574: 		return nil
1575: 	}
1576: 	now := time.Now().Unix()
1577: 	out := make([]*ModelInfo, 0, len(models))
1578: 	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(models))
1579: 	for i := range models {
1580: 		model := models[i]
1581: 		name := strings.TrimSpace(model.GetName())
1582: 		alias := strings.TrimSpace(model.GetAlias())
1583: 		if alias == "" {
1584: 			alias = name
1585: 		}
1586: 		if alias == "" {
1587: 			continue
1588: 		}
1589: 		key := strings.ToLower(alias)
1590: 		if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
1591: 			continue
1592: 		}
1593: 		seen[key] = struct{}{}
1594: 		display := name
1595: 		if display == "" {
1596: 			display = alias
1597: 		}
1598: 		info := &ModelInfo{
1599: 			ID:          alias,
1600: 			Object:      "model",
1601: 			Created:     now,
1602: 			OwnedBy:     ownedBy,
1603: 			Type:        modelType,
1604: 			DisplayName: display,
1605: 			UserDefined: true,
1606: 		}
1607: 		if name != "" {
1608: 			if upstream := registry.LookupStaticModelInfo(name); upstream != nil && upstream.Thinking != nil {
1609: 				info.Thinking = upstream.Thinking
1610: 			}
1611: 		}
1612: 		out = append(out, info)
1613: 	}
1614: 	return out
1615: }

1645: func rewriteModelInfoName(name, oldID, newID string) string {
1646: 	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(name)
1647: 	if trimmed == "" {
1648: 		return name
1649: 	}
1650: 	oldID = strings.TrimSpace(oldID)
1651: 	newID = strings.TrimSpace(newID)
1652: 	if oldID == "" || newID == "" {
1653: 		return name
1654: 	}
1655: 	if strings.EqualFold(oldID, newID) {
1656: 		return name
1657: 	}
1658: 	if strings.EqualFold(trimmed, oldID) {
1659: 		return newID
1660: 	}
1661: 	if strings.HasSuffix(trimmed, "/"+oldID) {
1662: 		prefix := strings.TrimSuffix(trimmed, oldID)
1663: 		return prefix + newID
1664: 	}
1665: 	if trimmed == "models/"+oldID {
1666: 		return "models/" + newID
1667: 	}
1668: 	return name
1669: }

1671: func applyOAuthModelAlias(cfg *config.Config, provider, authKind string, models []*ModelInfo) []*ModelInfo {
1672: 	if cfg == nil || len(models) == 0 {
1673: 		return models
1674: 	}
1675: 	channel := coreauth.OAuthModelAliasChannel(provider, authKind)
1676: 	if channel == "" || len(cfg.OAuthModelAlias) == 0 {
1677: 		return models
1678: 	}
1679: 	aliases := cfg.OAuthModelAlias[channel]
1680: 	if len(aliases) == 0 {
1681: 		return models
1682: 	}
1683: 
1684: 	type aliasEntry struct {
1685: 		alias string
1686: 		fork  bool
1687: 	}
1688: 
1689: 	forward := make(map[string][]aliasEntry, len(aliases))
1690: 	for i := range aliases {
1691: 		name := strings.TrimSpace(aliases[i].Name)
1692: 		alias := strings.TrimSpace(aliases[i].Alias)
1693: 		if name == "" || alias == "" {
1694: 			continue
1695: 		}
1696: 		if strings.EqualFold(name, alias) {
1697: 			continue
1698: 		}
1699: 		key := strings.ToLower(name)
1700: 		forward[key] = append(forward[key], aliasEntry{alias: alias, fork: aliases[i].Fork})
1701: 	}
1702: 	if len(forward) == 0 {
1703: 		return models
1704: 	}
1705: 
1706: 	out := make([]*ModelInfo, 0, len(models))
1707: 	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(models))
1708: 	for _, model := range models {
1709: 		if model == nil {
1710: 			continue
1711: 		}
1712: 		id := strings.TrimSpace(model.ID)
1713: 		if id == "" {
1714: 			continue
1715: 		}
1716: 		key := strings.ToLower(id)
1717: 		entries := forward[key]
1718: 		if len(entries) == 0 {
1719: 			if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
1720: 				continue
1721: 			}
1722: 			seen[key] = struct{}{}
1723: 			out = append(out, model)
1724: 			continue
1725: 		}
1726: 
1727: 		keepOriginal := false
1728: 		for _, entry := range entries {
1729: 			if entry.fork {
1730: 				keepOriginal = true
1731: 				break
1732: 			}
1733: 		}
1734: 		if keepOriginal {
1735: 			if _, exists := seen[key]; !exists {
1736: 				seen[key] = struct{}{}
1737: 				out = append(out, model)
1738: 			}
1739: 		}
1740: 
1741: 		addedAlias := false
1742: 		for _, entry := range entries {
1743: 			mappedID := strings.TrimSpace(entry.alias)
1744: 			if mappedID == "" {
1745: 				continue
1746: 			}
1747: 			if strings.EqualFold(mappedID, id) {
1748: 				continue
1749: 			}
1750: 			aliasKey := strings.ToLower(mappedID)
1751: 			if _, exists := seen[aliasKey]; exists {
1752: 				continue
1753: 			}
1754: 			seen[aliasKey] = struct{}{}
1755: 			clone := *model
1756: 			clone.ID = mappedID
1757: 			if clone.Name != "" {
1758: 				clone.Name = rewriteModelInfoName(clone.Name, id, mappedID)
1759: 			}
1760: 			out = append(out, &clone)
1761: 			addedAlias = true
1762: 		}
1763: 
1764: 		if !keepOriginal && !addedAlias {
1765: 			if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
1766: 				continue
1767: 			}
1768: 			seen[key] = struct{}{}
1769: 			out = append(out, model)
1770: 		}
1771: 	}
1772: 	return out
1773: }

 338: func (s *Server) homeHeartbeatMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
 339: 	return func(c *gin.Context) {
 340: 		if s == nil || s.cfg == nil || !s.cfg.Home.Enabled {
 341: 			c.Next()
 342: 			return
 343: 		}
 344: 		if c != nil && c.Request != nil {
 345: 			path := c.Request.URL.Path
 346: 			if strings.HasPrefix(path, "/v0/management/") || path == "/v0/management" || path == "/management.html" {
 347: 				c.Next()
 348: 				return
 349: 			}
 350: 		}
 351: 		client := home.Current()
 352: 		if client == nil || !client.HeartbeatOK() {
 353: 			c.AbortWithStatus(http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
 354: 			return
 355: 		}
 356: 		c.Next()

 490: // AttachWebsocketRoute registers a websocket upgrade handler on the primary Gin engine.
 491: // The handler is served as-is without additional middleware beyond the standard stack already configured.
 492: func (s *Server) AttachWebsocketRoute(path string, handler http.Handler) {
 493: 	if s == nil || s.engine == nil || handler == nil {
 494: 		return
 495: 	}
 496: 	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(path)
 497: 	if trimmed == "" {
 498: 		trimmed = "/v1/ws"
 499: 	}
 500: 	if !strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "/") {
 501: 		trimmed = "/" + trimmed
 502: 	}
 503: 	s.wsRouteMu.Lock()
 504: 	if _, exists := s.wsRoutes[trimmed]; exists {
 505: 		s.wsRouteMu.Unlock()
 506: 		return
 507: 	}
 508: 	s.wsRoutes[trimmed] = struct{}{}
 509: 	s.wsRouteMu.Unlock()
 510: 
 511: 	authMiddleware := AuthMiddleware(s.accessManager)
 512: 	conditionalAuth := func(c *gin.Context) {
 513: 		if !s.wsAuthEnabled.Load() {
 514: 			c.Next()
 515: 			return
 516: 		}
 517: 		authMiddleware(c)
 518: 	}
 519: 	finalHandler := func(c *gin.Context) {
 520: 		handler.ServeHTTP(c.Writer, c.Request)
 521: 		c.Abort()
 522: 	}
 523: 
 524: 	s.engine.GET(trimmed, conditionalAuth, finalHandler)
 525: }
 526: 
 527: func (s *Server) registerManagementRoutes() {
 528: 	if s == nil || s.engine == nil || s.mgmt == nil {
 529: 		return
 530: 	}
 531: 	if !s.managementRoutesRegistered.CompareAndSwap(false, true) {
 532: 		return
 533: 	}
 534:

 692: 
 693: func (s *Server) managementAvailabilityMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
 694: 	return func(c *gin.Context) {
 695: 		if s == nil || s.cfg == nil {
 696: 			c.AbortWithStatus(http.StatusNotFound)
 697: 			return
 698: 		}
 699: 		if s.cfg.Home.Enabled {
 700: 			c.AbortWithStatus(http.StatusNotFound)
 701: 			return
 702: 		}
 703: 		if !s.managementRoutesEnabled.Load() {
 704: 			c.AbortWithStatus(http.StatusNotFound)
 705: 			return
 706: 		}
 707: 		c.Next()
 708: 	}
 709: }
 710: 
 711: func (s *Server) serveManagementControlPanel(c *gin.Context) {
 712: 	cfg := s.cfg
 713: 	if cfg == nil || cfg.Home.Enabled || cfg.RemoteManagement.DisableControlPanel {
 714: 		c.AbortWithStatus(http.StatusNotFound)
 715: 		return
 716: 	}
 717: 	filePath := managementasset.FilePath(s.configFilePath)
 718: 	if strings.TrimSpace(filePath) == "" {
 719: 		c.AbortWithStatus(http.StatusNotFound)
 720: 		return
 721: 	}
 722: 
 723: 	if _, err := os.Stat(filePath); err != nil {
 724: 		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
 725: 			// Synchronously ensure management.html is available with a detached context.
 726: 			// Control panel bootstrap should not be canceled by client disconnects.
 727: 			if !managementasset.EnsureLatestManagementHTML(context.Background(), managementasset.StaticDir(s.configFilePath), cfg.ProxyURL, cfg.RemoteManagement.PanelGitHubRepository) {
 728: 				c.AbortWithStatus(http.StatusNotFound)
 729: 				return
 730: 			}
 731: 		} else {
 732: 			log.WithError(err).Error("failed to stat management control panel asset")
 733: 			c.AbortWithStatus(http.StatusInternalServerError)
 734: 			return
 735: 		}
 736: 	}
 737: 
 738: 	c.File(filePath)
 739: }
 740: 
 741: func (s *Server) enableKeepAlive(timeout time.Duration, onTimeout func()) {
 742: 	if timeout <= 0 || onTimeout == nil {
 743: 		return
 744: 	}
 745: 
 746: 	s.keepAliveEnabled = true
 747: 	s.keepAliveTimeout = timeout
 748: 	s.keepAliveOnTimeout = onTimeout
 749: 	s.keepAliveHeartbeat = make(chan struct{}, 1)
 750: 	s.keepAliveStop = make(chan struct{}, 1)
 751: 
 752: 	s.engine.GET("/keep-alive", s.handleKeepAlive)
 753: 
 754: 	go s.watchKeepAlive()
 755: }
 756: 
 757: func (s *Server) handleKeepAlive(c *gin.Context) {
 758: 	if s.localPassword != "" {
 759: 		provided := strings.TrimSpace(c.GetHeader("Authorization"))
 760: 		if provided != "" {
 761: 			parts := strings.SplitN(provided, " ", 2)
 762: 			if len(parts) == 2 && strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "bearer") {
 763: 				provided = parts[1]
 764: 			}
 765: 		}
 766: 		if provided == "" {
 767: 			provided = strings.TrimSpace(c.GetHeader("X-Local-Password"))
 768: 		}
 769: 		if subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(provided), []byte(s.localPassword)) != 1 {
 770: 			c.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusUnauthorized, gin.H{"error": "invalid password"})
 771: 			return
 772: 		}
 773: 	}
 774: 
 775: 	s.signalKeepAlive()
 776: 	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"status": "ok"})
 777: }
 778: 
 779: func (s *Server) signalKeepAlive() {
 780: 	if !s.keepAliveEnabled {
 781: 		return
 782: 	}
 783: 	select {
 784: 	case s.keepAliveHeartbeat <- struct{}{}:
 785: 	default:
 786: 	}
 787: }
 788: 
 789: func (s *Server) watchKeepAlive() {
 790: 	if !s.keepAliveEnabled {
 791: 		return
 792: 	}
 793: 
 794: 	timer := time.NewTimer(s.keepAliveTimeout)
 795: 	defer timer.Stop()
 796: 
 797: 	for {
 798: 		select {
 799: 		case <-timer.C:
 800: 			log.Warnf("keep-alive endpoint idle for %s, shutting down", s.keepAliveTimeout)
 801: 			if s.keepAliveOnTimeout != nil {
 802: 				s.keepAliveOnTimeout()
 803: 			}
 804: 			return
 805: 		case <-s.keepAliveHeartbeat:
 806: 			if !timer.Stop() {
 807: 				select {
 808: 				case <-timer.C:
 809: 				default:
 810: 				}
 811: 			}
 812: 			timer.Reset(s.keepAliveTimeout)
 813: 		case <-s.keepAliveStop:
 814: 			return
 815: 		}
 816: 	}
 817: }
 818: 
 819: // unifiedModelsHandler creates a unified handler for the /v1/models endpoint
 820: // that routes to different handlers based on the User-Agent header.
 821: // If User-Agent starts with "claude-cli", it routes to Claude handler,
 822: // otherwise it routes to OpenAI handler.
 823: func (s *Server) unifiedModelsHandler(openaiHandler *openai.OpenAIAPIHandler, claudeHandler *claude.ClaudeCodeAPIHandler) gin.HandlerFunc {
 824: 	return func(c *gin.Context) {
 825: 		if s != nil && s.cfg != nil && s.cfg.Home.Enabled {
 826: 			s.handleHomeModels(c)
 827: 			return
 828: 		}
 829: 
 830: 		userAgent := c.GetHeader("User-Agent")
 831: 
 832: 		// Route to Claude handler if User-Agent starts with "claude-cli"
 833: 		if strings.HasPrefix(userAgent, "claude-cli") {
 834: 			// log.Debugf("Routing /v1/models to Claude handler for User-Agent: %s", userAgent)
 835: 			claudeHandler.ClaudeModels(c)
 836: 		} else {
 837: 			// log.Debugf("Routing /v1/models to OpenAI handler for User-Agent: %s", userAgent)
 838: 			openaiHandler.OpenAIModels(c)
 839: 		}
 840: 	}
 841: }
 842: 
 843: type homeModelEntry struct {
 844: 	id          string
 845: 	created     int64
 846: 	ownedBy     string
 847: 	displayName string
 848: }
 849: 
 850: func (s *Server) handleHomeModels(c *gin.Context) {
 851: 	if s == nil || c == nil || c.Request == nil {
 852: 		return
 853: 	}
 854: 	client := home.Current()
 855: 	if client == nil {
 856: 		c.JSON(http.StatusServiceUnavailable, handlers.ErrorResponse{
 857: 			Error: handlers.ErrorDetail{
 858: 				Message: "home control center unavailable",
 859: 				Type:    "server_error",
 860: 			},
 861: 		})
 862: 		return
 863: 	}
 864: 
 865: 	raw, errGet := client.GetModels(c.Request.Context())
 866: 	if errGet != nil {
 867: 		c.JSON(http.StatusBadGateway, handlers.ErrorResponse{
 868: 			Error: handlers.ErrorDetail{
 869: 				Message: errGet.Error(),
 870: 				Type:    "server_error",
 871: 			},
 872: 		})
 873: 		return
 874: 	}
 875: 
 876: 	entries, errDecode := decodeHomeModels(raw)
 877: 	if errDecode != nil {
 878: 		c.JSON(http.StatusBadGateway, handlers.ErrorResponse{
 879: 			Error: handlers.ErrorDetail{
 880: 				Message: errDecode.Error(),
 881: 				Type:    "server_error",
 882: 			},
 883: 		})
 884: 		return
 885: 	}
 886: 
 887: 	userAgent := c.GetHeader("User-Agent")
 888: 	isClaude := strings.HasPrefix(userAgent, "claude-cli")
 889: 
 890: 	if isClaude {
 891: 		out := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(entries))
 892: 		for _, entry := range entries {
 893: 			model := map[string]any{
 894: 				"id":       entry.id,
 895: 				"object":   "model",
 896: 				"owned_by": entry.ownedBy,
 897: 			}
 898: 			if entry.created > 0 {
 899: 				model["created_at"] = entry.created
 900: 			}
 901: 			if entry.displayName != "" {
 902: 				model["display_name"] = entry.displayName
 903: 			}
 904: 			out = append(out, model)
 905: 		}
 906: 		firstID := ""
 907: 		lastID := ""
 908: 		if len(out) > 0 {
 909: 			if id, ok := out[0]["id"].(string); ok {
 910: 				firstID = id
 911: 			}
 912: 			if id, ok := out[len(out)-1]["id"].(string); ok {
 913: 				lastID = id
 914: 			}
 915: 		}
 916: 		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{
 917: 			"data":     out,
 918: 			"has_more": false,
 919: 			"first_id": firstID,
 920: 			"last_id":  lastID,
 921: 		})
 922: 		return
 923: 	}
 924: 
 925: 	filtered := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(entries))
 926: 	for _, entry := range entries {
 927: 		model := map[string]any{
 928: 			"id":     entry.id,
 929: 			"object": "model",
 930: 		}
 931: 		if entry.created > 0 {
 932: 			model["created"] = entry.created
 933: 		}
 934: 		if entry.ownedBy != "" {
 935: 			model["owned_by"] = entry.ownedBy
 936: 		}
 937: 		filtered = append(filtered, model)
 938: 	}
 939: 	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{
 940: 		"object": "list",
 941: 		"data":   filtered,
 942: 	})
 943: }
 944: 
 945: func decodeHomeModels(raw []byte) ([]homeModelEntry, error) {
 946: 	if len(raw) == 0 {
 947: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("home models payload is empty")
 948: 	}
 949: 
 950: 	var bySection map[string][]map[string]any
 951: 	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &bySection); err != nil {
 952: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse home models payload: %w", err)
 953: 	}
 954: 	if len(bySection) == 0 {
 955: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("home models payload has no sections")
 956: 	}
 957: 
 958: 	seen := make(map[string]struct{})
 959: 	out := make([]homeModelEntry, 0, 256)
 960: 	for _, models := range bySection {
 961: 		for _, model := range models {
 962: 			id, _ := model["id"].(string)
 963: 			id = strings.TrimSpace(id)
 964: 			if id == "" {
 965: 				continue
 966: 			}
 967: 			if _, ok := seen[id]; ok {
 968: 				continue
 969: 			}
 970: 			seen[id] = struct{}{}
 971: 
 972: 			created := int64(0)
 973: 			switch v := model["created"].(type) {
 974: 			case float64:
 975: 				created = int64(v)
 976: 			case int64:
 977: 				created = v
 978: 			case int:
 979: 				created = int64(v)
 980: 			case json.Number:
 981: 				if n, err := v.Int64(); err == nil {
 982: 					created = n
 983: 				}
 984: 			}
 985: 
 986: 			ownedBy, _ := model["owned_by"].(string)
 987: 			ownedBy = strings.TrimSpace(ownedBy)
 988: 			displayName, _ := model["display_name"].(string)
 989: 			displayName = strings.TrimSpace(displayName)
 990: 
 991: 			out = append(out, homeModelEntry{
 992: 				id:          id,
 993: 				created:     created,
 994: 				ownedBy:     ownedBy,
 995: 				displayName: displayName,
 996: 			})
 997: 		}
 998: 	}
 999: 
1000: 	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].id < out[j].id })
1001: 	if len(out) == 0 {
1002: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("home models payload contains no models")
1003: 	}
1004: 	return out, nil
1005: }

  31: 	if errors.Is(err, net.ErrClosed) {
  32: 		return nil
  33: 	}
  34: 	return err
  35: }

  37: func (s *Server) acceptMuxConnections(listener net.Listener, httpListener *muxListener) error {
  38: 	if s == nil || listener == nil {
  39: 		return net.ErrClosed
  40: 	}
  41: 
  42: 	for {
  43: 		conn, errAccept := listener.Accept()
  44: 		if errAccept != nil {
  45: 			return errAccept
  46: 		}
  47: 		if conn == nil {
  48: 			continue
  49: 		}
  50: 
  51: 		tlsConn, ok := conn.(*tls.Conn)
  52: 		if ok {
  53: 			if errHandshake := tlsConn.Handshake(); errHandshake != nil {
  54: 				if errClose := conn.Close(); errClose != nil {
  55: 					log.Errorf("failed to close connection after TLS handshake error: %v", errClose)
  56: 				}
  57: 				continue
  58: 			}
  59: 			proto := strings.TrimSpace(tlsConn.ConnectionState().NegotiatedProtocol)
  60: 			if proto == "h2" || proto == "http/1.1" {
  61: 				if httpListener == nil {
  62: 					if errClose := conn.Close(); errClose != nil {
  63: 						log.Errorf("failed to close connection: %v", errClose)
  64: 					}
  65: 					continue
  66: 				}
  67: 				if errPut := httpListener.Put(tlsConn); errPut != nil {
  68: 					if errClose := conn.Close(); errClose != nil {
  69: 						log.Errorf("failed to close connection after HTTP routing failure: %v", errClose)
  70: 					}
  71: 				}
  72: 				continue
  73: 			}
  74: 		}
  75: 
  76: 		reader := bufio.NewReader(conn)
  77: 		prefix, errPeek := reader.Peek(1)
  78: 		if errPeek != nil {
  79: 			if errClose := conn.Close(); errClose != nil {
  80: 				log.Errorf("failed to close connection after protocol peek failure: %v", errClose)
  81: 			}
  82: 			continue
  83: 		}
  84: 
  85: 		if isRedisRESPPrefix(prefix[0]) {
  86: 			if s.cfg != nil && s.cfg.Home.Enabled {
  87: 				if errClose := conn.Close(); errClose != nil {
  88: 					log.Errorf("failed to close redis connection while home mode is enabled: %v", errClose)
  89: 				}
  90: 				continue
  91: 			}
  92: 			if !s.managementRoutesEnabled.Load() {
  93: 				if errClose := conn.Close(); errClose != nil {
  94: 					log.Errorf("failed to close redis connection while management is disabled: %v", errClose)
  95: 				}
  96: 				continue
  97: 			}
  98: 			go s.handleRedisConnection(conn, reader)
  99: 			continue
 100: 		}
 101: 
 102: 		if httpListener == nil {
 103: 			if errClose := conn.Close(); errClose != nil {
 104: 				log.Errorf("failed to close connection without HTTP listener: %v", errClose)
 105: 			}
 106: 			continue
 107: 		}
 108: 
 109: 		if errPut := httpListener.Put(&bufferedConn{Conn: conn, reader: reader}); errPut != nil {
 110: 			if errClose := conn.Close(); errClose != nil {
 111: 				log.Errorf("failed to close connection after HTTP routing failure: %v", errClose)
 112: 			}
 113: 		}
 114: 	}

 743: //   - ctx: The context for controlling the service lifecycle
 744: //
 745: // Returns:
 746: //   - error: An error if the service fails to start or run
 747: func (s *Service) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
 748: 	if s == nil {
 749: 		return fmt.Errorf("cliproxy: service is nil")
 750: 	}
 751: 	if ctx == nil {
 752: 		ctx = context.Background()
 753: 	}
 754: 
 755: 	usage.StartDefault(ctx)
 756: 	homeEnabled := s.cfg != nil && s.cfg.Home.Enabled
 757: 	if homeEnabled {
 758: 		forceHomeRuntimeConfig(s.cfg)
 759: 		redisqueue.SetUsageStatisticsEnabled(true)
 760: 	}
 761: 
 762: 	shutdownCtx, shutdownCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
 763: 	defer shutdownCancel()
 764: 	defer func() {
 765: 		if err := s.Shutdown(shutdownCtx); err != nil {
 766: 			log.Errorf("service shutdown returned error: %v", err)
 767: 		}
 768: 	}()
 769: 
 770: 	if !homeEnabled {
 771: 		if errEnsureAuthDir := s.ensureAuthDir(); errEnsureAuthDir != nil {
 772: 			return errEnsureAuthDir
 773: 		}
 774: 	}
 775: 
 776: 	s.applyRetryConfig(s.cfg)
 777: 
 778: 	if s.coreManager != nil && !homeEnabled {
 779: 		if errLoad := s.coreManager.Load(ctx); errLoad != nil {
 780: 			log.Warnf("failed to load auth store: %v", errLoad)
 781: 		}
 782: 	}
 783: 
 784: 	if !homeEnabled {
 785: 		tokenResult, err := s.tokenProvider.Load(ctx, s.cfg)
 786: 		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
 787: 			return err
 788: 		}
 789: 		if tokenResult == nil {
 790: 			tokenResult = &TokenClientResult{}
 791: 		}
 792: 
 793: 		apiKeyResult, err := s.apiKeyProvider.Load(ctx, s.cfg)
 794: 		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
 795: 			return err
 796: 		}
 797: 		if apiKeyResult == nil {
 798: 			apiKeyResult = &APIKeyClientResult{}

 801: 
 802: 	// legacy clients removed; no caches to refresh
 803: 
 804: 	// handlers no longer depend on legacy clients; pass nil slice initially
 805: 	s.server = api.NewServer(s.cfg, s.coreManager, s.accessManager, s.configPath, s.serverOptions...)
 806: 
 807: 	if s.authManager == nil {
 808: 		s.authManager = newDefaultAuthManager()
 809: 	}
 810:

 813: 	}

 818: 		s.server.SetWebsocketAuthChangeHandler(func(oldEnabled, newEnabled bool) {
 819: 			if oldEnabled == newEnabled {
 820: 				return
 821: 			}
 822: 			if !oldEnabled && newEnabled {
---
 859: 
 860: 		auths := s.coreManager.List()
 861: 		refreshed := 0
 862: 		for _, item := range auths {
 863: 			if item == nil || item.ID == "" {
 864: 				continue
 865: 			}
 866: 			auth, ok := s.coreManager.GetByID(item.ID)
 867: 			if !ok || auth == nil || auth.Disabled {
 868: 				continue
 869: 			}
 870: 			provider := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(auth.Provider))
 871: 			if !providerSet[provider] {
 872: 				continue
 873: 			}
 874: 			if s.refreshModelRegistrationForAuth(auth) {
 875: 				refreshed++
 876: 			}
 877: 		}
 878: 
 879: 		if refreshed > 0 {
 880: 			log.Infof("re-registered models for %d auth(s) due to model catalog changes: %v", refreshed, changedProviders)
 881: 		}
 882: 	})
 883: 
 884: 	s.serverErr = make(chan error, 1)
 885: 	go func() {

 887: 			s.serverErr <- errStart
 888: 		} else {
 889: 			s.serverErr <- nil
 890: 		}
 891: 	}()
 892: 
 893: 	time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
 894: 	fmt.Printf("API server started successfully on: %s:%d\n", s.cfg.Host, s.cfg.Port)
 895: 
 896: 	s.applyPprofConfig(s.cfg)
 897: 
 898: 	if s.hooks.OnAfterStart != nil {
 899: 		s.hooks.OnAfterStart(s)
 900: 	}
 901: 
 902: 	if !homeEnabled {

 930: 	}

 935: 		return ctx.Err()

1007: // Start begins listening for and serving HTTP or HTTPS requests.
1008: // It's a blocking call and will only return on an unrecoverable error.
1009: //
1010: // Returns:
1011: //   - error: An error if the server fails to start
1012: func (s *Server) Start() error {
1013: 	if s == nil || s.server == nil {
1014: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to start HTTP server: server not initialized")
1015: 	}
1016: 
1017: 	addr := s.server.Addr
1018: 	listener, errListen := net.Listen("tcp", addr)
1019: 	if errListen != nil {
1020: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to start HTTP server: %v", errListen)
1021: 	}
1022: 
1023: 	useTLS := s.cfg != nil && s.cfg.TLS.Enable
1024: 	if useTLS {
1025: 		certPath := strings.TrimSpace(s.cfg.TLS.Cert)
1026: 		keyPath := strings.TrimSpace(s.cfg.TLS.Key)
1027: 		if certPath == "" || keyPath == "" {
1028: 			if errClose := listener.Close(); errClose != nil {
1029: 				log.Errorf("failed to close listener after TLS validation failure: %v", errClose)
1030: 			}
1031: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to start HTTPS server: tls.cert or tls.key is empty")
1032: 		}
1033: 		certPair, errLoad := tls.LoadX509KeyPair(certPath, keyPath)
1034: 		if errLoad != nil {
1035: 			if errClose := listener.Close(); errClose != nil {
1036: 				log.Errorf("failed to close listener after TLS key pair load failure: %v", errClose)
1037: 			}
1038: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to start HTTPS server: %v", errLoad)
1039: 		}

 149: func (w *Watcher) addOrUpdateClient(path string) {
 150: 	data, errRead := os.ReadFile(path)
 151: 	if errRead != nil {
 152: 		log.Errorf("failed to read auth file %s: %v", filepath.Base(path), errRead)
 153: 		return
 154: 	}
 155: 	if len(data) == 0 {
 156: 		log.Debugf("ignoring empty auth file: %s", filepath.Base(path))
 157: 		return
 158: 	}
 159: 
 160: 	sum := sha256.Sum256(data)
 161: 	curHash := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
 162: 	normalized := w.normalizeAuthPath(path)
 163: 
 164: 	// Parse new auth content for diff comparison
 165: 	var newAuth coreauth.Auth
 166: 	if errParse := json.Unmarshal(data, &newAuth); errParse != nil {
 167: 		log.Errorf("failed to parse auth file %s: %v", filepath.Base(path), errParse)
 168: 		return
 169: 	}
 170: 
 171: 	w.clientsMutex.Lock()
 172: 	if w.config == nil {
 173: 		log.Error("config is nil, cannot add or update client")
 174: 		w.clientsMutex.Unlock()
 175: 		return
 176: 	}
 177: 	if w.fileAuthsByPath == nil {
 178: 		w.fileAuthsByPath = make(map[string]map[string]*coreauth.Auth)
 179: 	}
 180: 	if prev, ok := w.lastAuthHashes[normalized]; ok && prev == curHash {
 181: 		log.Debugf("auth file unchanged (hash match), skipping reload: %s", filepath.Base(path))
 182: 		w.clientsMutex.Unlock()
 183: 		return
 184: 	}
 185: 
 186: 	// Get old auth for diff comparison
 187: 	cacheAuthContents := log.IsLevelEnabled(log.DebugLevel)
 188: 	var oldAuth *coreauth.Auth
 189: 	if cacheAuthContents && w.lastAuthContents != nil {
 190: 		oldAuth = w.lastAuthContents[normalized]
 191: 	}
 192: 
 193: 	// Compute and log field changes
 194: 	if cacheAuthContents {
 195: 		if changes := diff.BuildAuthChangeDetails(oldAuth, &newAuth); len(changes) > 0 {
 196: 			log.Debugf("auth field changes for %s:", filepath.Base(path))
 197: 			for _, c := range changes {
 198: 				log.Debugf("  %s", c)
 199: 			}
 200: 		}
 201: 	}
 202: 
 203: 	// Update caches
 204: 	w.lastAuthHashes[normalized] = curHash
 205: 	if cacheAuthContents {
 206: 		if w.lastAuthContents == nil {
 207: 			w.lastAuthContents = make(map[string]*coreauth.Auth)
 208: 		}
 209: 		w.lastAuthContents[normalized] = &newAuth
 210: 	}
 211: 
 212: 	oldByID := make(map[string]*coreauth.Auth, len(w.fileAuthsByPath[normalized]))
 213: 	for id, a := range w.fileAuthsByPath[normalized] {
 214: 		oldByID[id] = a
 215: 	}
 216: 
 217: 	// Build synthesized auth entries for this single file only.
 218: 	sctx := &synthesizer.SynthesisContext{
 219: 		Config:      w.config,
 220: 		AuthDir:     w.authDir,
 221: 		Now:         time.Now(),
 222: 		IDGenerator: synthesizer.NewStableIDGenerator(),
 223: 	}
 224: 	generated := synthesizer.SynthesizeAuthFile(sctx, path, data)
 225: 	newByID := authSliceToMap(generated)
 226: 	if len(newByID) > 0 {
 227: 		w.fileAuthsByPath[normalized] = authIDSet(newByID)
 228: 	} else {
 229: 		delete(w.fileAuthsByPath, normalized)
 230: 	}
 231: 	updates := w.computePerPathUpdatesLocked(oldByID, newByID)
 232: 	w.clientsMutex.Unlock()
 233: 
 234: 	w.persistAuthAsync(fmt.Sprintf("Sync auth %s", filepath.Base(path)), path)
 235: 	w.dispatchAuthUpdates(updates)

 249: 	updates := w.computePerPathUpdatesLocked(oldByID, map[string]*coreauth.Auth{})
 250: 	w.clientsMutex.Unlock()
 251: 
 252: 	w.persistAuthAsync(fmt.Sprintf("Remove auth %s", filepath.Base(path)), path)
 253: 	w.dispatchAuthUpdates(updates)
 254: }

 256: func (w *Watcher) computePerPathUpdatesLocked(oldByID, newByID map[string]*coreauth.Auth) []AuthUpdate {
 257: 	if w.currentAuths == nil {
 258: 		w.currentAuths = make(map[string]*coreauth.Auth)
 259: 	}
 260: 	updates := make([]AuthUpdate, 0, len(oldByID)+len(newByID))
 261: 	for id, newAuth := range newByID {
 262: 		existing, ok := w.currentAuths[id]
 263: 		if !ok {
 264: 			w.currentAuths[id] = newAuth.Clone()
 265: 			updates = append(updates, AuthUpdate{Action: AuthUpdateActionAdd, ID: id, Auth: newAuth.Clone()})
 266: 			continue
 267: 		}
 268: 		if !authEqual(existing, newAuth) {
 269: 			w.currentAuths[id] = newAuth.Clone()
 270: 			updates = append(updates, AuthUpdate{Action: AuthUpdateActionModify, ID: id, Auth: newAuth.Clone()})
 271: 		}
 272: 	}
 273: 	for id := range oldByID {
 274: 		if _, stillExists := newByID[id]; stillExists {
 275: 			continue
 276: 		}
 277: 		delete(w.currentAuths, id)
 278: 		updates = append(updates, AuthUpdate{Action: AuthUpdateActionDelete, ID: id})
 279: 	}
 280: 	return updates
 281: }

 283: func authSliceToMap(auths []*coreauth.Auth) map[string]*coreauth.Auth {
 284: 	byID := make(map[string]*coreauth.Auth, len(auths))
 285: 	for _, a := range auths {
 286: 		if a == nil || strings.TrimSpace(a.ID) == "" {
 287: 			continue
 288: 		}
 289: 		byID[a.ID] = a
 290: 	}
 291: 	return byID
 292: }

 302: func (w *Watcher) loadFileClients(cfg *config.Config) int {
 303: 	authFileCount := 0
 304: 	successfulAuthCount := 0
 305: 
 306: 	authDir, errResolveAuthDir := util.ResolveAuthDir(cfg.AuthDir)
 307: 	if errResolveAuthDir != nil {
 308: 		log.Errorf("failed to resolve auth directory: %v", errResolveAuthDir)
 309: 		return 0
 310: 	}
 311: 	if authDir == "" {
 312: 		return 0
 313: 	}
 314: 
 315: 	entries, errReadDir := os.ReadDir(authDir)
 316: 	if errReadDir != nil {
 317: 		log.Errorf("error reading auth directory: %v", errReadDir)
 318: 		return 0
 319: 	}
 320: 	for _, entry := range entries {
 321: 		if entry == nil || entry.IsDir() {
 322: 			continue
 323: 		}
 324: 		name := entry.Name()
 325: 		if !strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(name), ".json") {
 326: 			continue
 327: 		}
 328: 		authFileCount++
 329: 		log.Debugf("processing auth file %d: %s", authFileCount, name)
 330: 		fullPath := filepath.Join(authDir, name)
 331: 		if data, errReadFile := os.ReadFile(fullPath); errReadFile == nil && len(data) > 0 {
 332: 			successfulAuthCount++
 333: 		}
 334: 	}
 335: 	log.Debugf("auth directory scan complete - found %d .json files, %d readable", authFileCount, successfulAuthCount)
 336: 	return authFileCount
 337: }

 369: func (w *Watcher) persistConfigAsync() {

 371: 		return
 372: 	}
 373: 	go func() {

 375: 		defer cancel()

 377: 			log.Errorf("failed to persist config change: %v", err)
 378: 		}
 379: 	}()
 380: }

 382: func (w *Watcher) persistAuthAsync(message string, paths ...string) {
 383: 	if w == nil || w.storePersister == nil {
 384: 		return
 385: 	}
 386: 	filtered := make([]string, 0, len(paths))
 387: 	for _, p := range paths {
 388: 		if trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(p); trimmed != "" {
 389: 			filtered = append(filtered, trimmed)
 390: 		}
 391: 	}
 392: 	if len(filtered) == 0 {
 393: 		return
 394: 	}
 395: 	go func() {
 396: 		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
 397: 		defer cancel()
 398: 		if err := w.storePersister.PersistAuthFiles(ctx, message, filtered...); err != nil {
 399: 			log.Errorf("failed to persist auth changes: %v", err)
 400: 		}
 401: 	}()
 402: }

 404: func (w *Watcher) stopServerUpdateTimer() {
 405: 	w.serverUpdateMu.Lock()
 406: 	defer w.serverUpdateMu.Unlock()
 407: 	if w.serverUpdateTimer != nil {
 408: 		w.serverUpdateTimer.Stop()
 409: 		w.serverUpdateTimer = nil
 410: 	}
 411: 	w.serverUpdatePend = false
 412: }

 414: func (w *Watcher) triggerServerUpdate(cfg *config.Config) {
 415: 	if w == nil || w.reloadCallback == nil || cfg == nil {
 416: 		return
 417: 	}
 418: 	if w.stopped.Load() {
 419: 		return
 420: 	}
 421: 
 422: 	now := time.Now()
 423: 
 424: 	w.serverUpdateMu.Lock()
 425: 	if w.serverUpdateLast.IsZero() || now.Sub(w.serverUpdateLast) >= serverUpdateDebounce {
 426: 		w.serverUpdateLast = now
 427: 		if w.serverUpdateTimer != nil {
 428: 			w.serverUpdateTimer.Stop()
 429: 			w.serverUpdateTimer = nil
 430: 		}
 431: 		w.serverUpdatePend = false
 432: 		w.serverUpdateMu.Unlock()
 433: 		w.reloadCallback(cfg)
 434: 		return
 435: 	}
 436: 
 437: 	if w.serverUpdatePend {
 438: 		w.serverUpdateMu.Unlock()
 439: 		return
 440: 	}
 441: 
 442: 	delay := serverUpdateDebounce - now.Sub(w.serverUpdateLast)
 443: 	if delay < 10*time.Millisecond {
 444: 		delay = 10 * time.Millisecond
 445: 	}
 446: 	w.serverUpdatePend = true
 447: 	if w.serverUpdateTimer != nil {
 448: 		w.serverUpdateTimer.Stop()
 449: 		w.serverUpdateTimer = nil
 450: 	}
 451: 	var timer *time.Timer
 452: 	timer = time.AfterFunc(delay, func() {
 453: 		if w.stopped.Load() {
 454: 			return
 455: 		}
 456: 		w.clientsMutex.RLock()
 457: 		latestCfg := w.config
 458: 		w.clientsMutex.RUnlock()
 459: 
 460: 		w.serverUpdateMu.Lock()
 461: 		if w.serverUpdateTimer != timer || !w.serverUpdatePend {
 462: 			w.serverUpdateMu.Unlock()
 463: 			return
 464: 		}
 465: 		w.serverUpdateTimer = nil
 466: 		w.serverUpdatePend = false
 467: 		if latestCfg == nil || w.reloadCallback == nil || w.stopped.Load() {
 468: 			w.serverUpdateMu.Unlock()
 469: 			return
 470: 		}
 471: 
 472: 		w.serverUpdateLast = time.Now()
 473: 		w.serverUpdateMu.Unlock()
 474: 		w.reloadCallback(latestCfg)
 475: 	})
 476: 	w.serverUpdateTimer = timer
 477: 	w.serverUpdateMu.Unlock()
 478: }

  67: func (w *Watcher) handleEvent(event fsnotify.Event) {
  68: 	// Filter only relevant events: config file or auth-dir JSON files.
  69: 	configOps := fsnotify.Write | fsnotify.Create | fsnotify.Rename
  70: 	normalizedName := w.normalizeAuthPath(event.Name)
  71: 	normalizedConfigPath := w.normalizeAuthPath(w.configPath)
  72: 	normalizedAuthDir := w.normalizeAuthPath(w.authDir)
  73: 	isConfigEvent := normalizedName == normalizedConfigPath && event.Op&configOps != 0
  74: 	authOps := fsnotify.Create | fsnotify.Write | fsnotify.Remove | fsnotify.Rename
  75: 	isAuthJSON := filepath.Dir(normalizedName) == normalizedAuthDir && strings.HasSuffix(normalizedName, ".json") && event.Op&authOps != 0
  76: 	if !isConfigEvent && !isAuthJSON {
  77: 		// Ignore unrelated files (e.g., cookie snapshots *.cookie) and other noise.
  78: 		return
  79: 	}
  80: 
  81: 	now := time.Now()
  82: 	log.Debugf("file system event detected: %s %s", event.Op.String(), event.Name)
  83: 
  84: 	// Handle config file changes
  85: 	if isConfigEvent {
  86: 		log.Debugf("config file change details - operation: %s, timestamp: %s", event.Op.String(), now.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05.000"))
  87: 		w.scheduleConfigReload()
  88: 		return
  89: 	}
  90: 
  91: 	// Handle auth directory changes incrementally (.json only)
  92: 	if event.Op&(fsnotify.Remove|fsnotify.Rename) != 0 {
  93: 		if w.shouldDebounceRemove(normalizedName, now) {
  94: 			log.Debugf("debouncing remove event for %s", filepath.Base(event.Name))
  95: 			return
  96: 		}
  97: 		// Atomic replace on some platforms may surface as Rename (or Remove) before the new file is ready.
  98: 		// Wait briefly; if the path exists again, treat as an update instead of removal.
  99: 		time.Sleep(replaceCheckDelay)
 100: 		if _, statErr := os.Stat(event.Name); statErr == nil {
 101: 			if unchanged, errSame := w.authFileUnchanged(event.Name); errSame == nil && unchanged {
 102: 				log.Debugf("auth file unchanged (hash match), skipping reload: %s", filepath.Base(event.Name))
 103: 				return
 104: 			}
 105: 			log.Infof("auth file changed (%s): %s, processing incrementally", event.Op.String(), filepath.Base(event.Name))
 106: 			w.addOrUpdateClient(event.Name)
 107: 			return
 108: 		}
 109: 		if !w.isKnownAuthFile(event.Name) {
 110: 			log.Debugf("ignoring remove for unknown auth file: %s", filepath.Base(event.Name))
 111: 			return
 112: 		}
 113: 		log.Infof("auth file changed (%s): %s, processing incrementally", event.Op.String(), filepath.Base(event.Name))
 114: 		w.removeClient(event.Name)
 115: 		return
 116: 	}
 117: 	if event.Op&(fsnotify.Create|fsnotify.Write) != 0 {
 118: 		if unchanged, errSame := w.authFileUnchanged(event.Name); errSame == nil && unchanged {
 119: 			log.Debugf("auth file unchanged (hash match), skipping reload: %s", filepath.Base(event.Name))
 120: 			return
 121: 		}

 123: 		w.addOrUpdateClient(event.Name)

 127: func (w *Watcher) authFileUnchanged(path string) (bool, error) {
 128: 	data, errRead := os.ReadFile(path)
 129: 	if errRead != nil {
 130: 		return false, errRead
 131: 	}
 132: 	if len(data) == 0 {
 133: 		return false, nil
 134: 	}
 135: 	sum := sha256.Sum256(data)
 136: 	curHash := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
 137: 
 138: 	normalized := w.normalizeAuthPath(path)
 139: 	w.clientsMutex.RLock()
 140: 	prevHash, ok := w.lastAuthHashes[normalized]
 141: 	w.clientsMutex.RUnlock()
 142: 	if ok && prevHash == curHash {
 143: 		return true, nil
 144: 	}
 145: 	return false, nil
 146: }
